title: An Encore for Byomkesh
subtitle: A Reluctant Witness and a Deadly Secret
summary: When a brilliant inventor's refusal to divulge his secret formula seals his fate in a murder trial, Byomkesh Bakshi is drawn into a labyrinth of unresolved mysteries and hidden motives. As winter fades in Kolkata, a tense phone call hints that the case is far from closed—and only Byomkesh can uncover the truth behind the tragedy.
